title: Photo-to-PO for Tradesmen — B2B Procurement Agent
description: Electrician sends photo + 'need two of these tomorrow morning near Derby'. System identifies part, confirms characteristics, finds compatible alternatives, queries Screwfix/wholesalers/independents, compares price/stock/distance/delivery/trade discount. '2 × Hager ___ CEF Derby has stock. £42.80 ex VAT. Collect 07:30 tomorrow.'
